escena: SCENE (documentary, on location at a client's neighbourhood bakery at dawn): an Efeonce content producer in a plain charcoal cap and grey hoodie, caught at the exact moment she crouches and films the baker pulling a tray of bread from the oven with a phone on a small gimbal; the open oven mouth is the brightest thing in the frame and its warm light, together with cool daylight from the shop window, lights both faces and the steam rising from the bread. White tiled walls, steel racks, flour on the counter. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) crate carries the only blue. 35mm f/2.8. Nobody looks at the lens. No readable signs or labels, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the floury steel counter edge right at the lens, dissolved into blur
